page: Microsoft Azure DC2ads_v6 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCadsv6 server family. It features an x86_64 AMD processor with 2 dedicated virtual CPUs and is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance includes 77 GB of local SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage options. It does not feature integrated GPU hardware, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the DC2ads_v6 is classified as a general-purpose server. It is designed for workloads that require dedicated CPU resources and moderate memory capacity without the need for hardware acceleration. Suitable workloads include lightweight web serving, small databases, and general-purpose application hosting.
